policy.source_use: Old frames are pose estimation references only; never appearance references.
policy.appearance: Keep approved base-3 identity, palette and proportions consistent across all sheets.
policy.target_effects: No FX; do not redraw baked hearts, powder, glints or sparkles.
policy.extraction: Full native cells, decoded RGBA unmodified, alpha preserved, no resize, no scripted FX removal.
policy.deduplication: SHA-256 of full decoded RGBA bytes within each sheet; first row-major occurrence is canonical. Transparent RGB participates.

pose_estimation_risks.issue: Baked glints, powder clouds, sparkles and kiss hearts can confuse COCO keypoints; compact mirror/powder puff are props, not joints. c00-c07 touch-up hands are close to face.
Jump/crouch changes height; baked sparkles/hearts and checkered flag/pole from c06 may be mistaken for limbs. Do not use prop endpoints as wrists.
Stun/death nonupright poses, kiss hand-face overlap, back views and raised carry hands may produce unreliable COCO skeletons; manually validate inferred joints.
55 fully transparent unused cells excluded from pose requests.
